subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential/scope/config contract should be accepted?
rationale: The remaining request changes Google Chat credential storage, OAuth or event-subscription scopes, non-mentioned Space message visibility, and fallback behavior; source review can prove the gap but cannot choose that security and product boundary.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth Or Events Design
options.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

options.title: Keep Mentioned Webhook Behavior
options.body: Limit bundled Google Chat to service-account webhook events and @mention-triggered Spaces, while finishing thread-reply reliability separately.

options.title: Defer To Broader Workspace Auth
options.body: Hold this until Google Workspace integrations share a common consent, token, event-subscription, and admin-approval model.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth Or Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.
